content.title: Paul Thomas Anderson Gave “Special Thanks” to Maya Rudolph at the Oscars 2026
content.text: OSCARS 2026The longtime partners, who share four children, arrived separately, but left the ceremony with three statuettes for Anderson’s film One Battle After Another.March 15, 2026Maya Rudolph at the 98th Annual Oscars held at Dolby Theatre on March 15, 2026 in Hollywood, California. (Photo by JC Olivera/WWD via Getty Images)JC Olivera/Getty ImagesPaul Thomas Anderson and his partner, Maya Rudolph, were both at the Oscars 2026—but they appeared on the Oscar stage separately. Anderson won best director, best adapted screenplay, and best picture for his film One Battle After Another, while Rudolph was there to present a pair of awards with the cast of her comedy Bridesmaids, celebrating its 15th anniversary this year.Keep ReadingContinue reading with a Vanity Fair subscription and get unlimited access, exclusive newsletters, and more.
